fields.description: How this check runs: code (a deterministic evaluator from the rule engine), llm (the model decides — legacy behaviour), off (never runs).
fields.label: Rule Type

fields.description: The deterministic evaluator key (dotted name) — defaults to the tag code lower-cased. Must match a registered evaluator (or the check is skipped with a warning).
fields.label: Rule Key

fields.description: fixed: the tag's Severity field decides; computed: the evaluator's own severity; policy_table: the HISI Report Settings severity overrides map (falling back to the tag's severity).
fields.label: Severity Policy

fields.description: Optional JSON parameters for the evaluator (e.g. {"tolerance_pct": 5, "max_gap_months": 3}).
fields.label: Parameters (JSON)

fields.description: Bumped on every rule change; stamped on reports for reproducibility.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: The instruction given to the LLM for this check (legacy modes): what to look for in the data and what counts as a discrepancy.
fields.label: Instruction
